<h2 class="section-title">India Markets</h2>

<ul class="digest-points">
  <li><strong>Forex surge and banking rally:</strong> The Sensex and Nifty rebounded as massive forex inflows—reported between $127 billion and $136 billion—bolstered liquidity and triggered a rally in banking stocks, helping the rupee strengthen to 94.26 against the USD.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiswFBVV95cUxNYlZxZHIxNEdQRUlyVENHT3VwVzVDMkxZc0tESjVLVlRDRGNrY0J4d1ZtZWxqVm9SbVVScXM4MGlZWGp5RW1yTmRWRDdlNDlVWEhOdzZLWllwYjRueENsZVBaVWYzVmpueDdjal81X2t5cjh4eElBNE9MNFR2Q29udkdVNWFLallaNXVRbVN6YXhrcnRpRk04b2x6LUE4SURJX3JmUU03Zm5UNC1DaDBJSzliNA?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I1</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I6</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I8</a> <a href="https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMi-?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I11</a></span></li>
  <li><strong>Market performance:</strong> After a three-day losing streak, indices opened higher and reclaimed the 24,000 level on the Nifty, though trading later turned flat as gains in the banking sector were tempered by weakness in IT stocks.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMizAFBVV95cUxOTmNWQlc2WW5fREdKb25nVmtZWmRrazFjeENKVmhsV0JXMFVtQlB6MXVBRUF4ZFBRcGItNHJ5UUtvWFppSndLaUdicDhiS3FPOG84R0tldEU2SEtmQmJocnJSSnBCVlRiM1RQaGU3LVFfRHhyaG5nZWtEY1pDV21hX1E3cFRzeTlmV0RVMHNwc01pS3lYUVRqMUROZG9NVVJNNDY3dDNmOWg2UTVaTS1IT3h4VS1zVU02c1FfVFY4ellRZmlFWDhRSGpURmU?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I7</a> <a href="https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMi-_?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I9</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I10</a></span></li>
